hints.title: Boundary Character Tracking
hints.text: Only the first and last characters of the concatenated string influence future joins.

hints.title: Binary Placement Decisions
hints.text: For each subsequent word, decide between appending to the right or prepending to the left.

hints.title: Overlapping Character Discount
hints.text: Subtract one character length whenever the connecting boundaries match.

hints.title: Boundary DP Implementation

complexity.notes: State determined by current word index, first character, and last character.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating 2^n concat combinations without state memoization causes exponential timeout.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Table of size n * 26 * 26 bounds total subproblems.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that internal characters are irrelevant; only boundary letters affect future merges.
